Party 
----
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ----
For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Vishal Kumar Rai, Adv.

For the State : Mr. Vishwanath Roy, A.P.P.
 ----
 06/Dated: 17th January, 2024  1. Heard the parties.
2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Jama P.S. Case No.24 of 2018, corresponding to G.R Case No.155 of 2018, registered for the offence under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Dumka.
3.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the applicant is an Assistant Accountant and he has supposed to keep the record only.
Further, it has been submitted that the process of payment, other officials are involved and after verification the payment has been through the post office.
The process of withdrawal of money, this applicant has no role.
Further, it has been submitted that the police has neither taken any statement from him, nor any notice under Section 41(A) of the Cr.P.C has been issued.

On the above basis,
prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

sentences.text: Considering the above facts, I am inclined to grant the privilege of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Dumka, in connection with Jama P.S. Case No.24 of 2018, corresponding to G.R Case No.155 of 2018, subject to the condition as laid down under section 438(2) Cr.P.C.

Further, the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Raja/-
